# Chat to Markdown

> Browser extension that exports LLM chat conversations as clean Markdown or API-format YAML. Local-only.

- Site: https://chatup.therobot.codes/
- Source: https://github.com/the-robot-lives/chat-to-markdown
- Privacy: https://chatup.therobot.codes/privacy
- License: MIT
- Publisher: TheRobotLives (https://therobotlives.com)

## Product

Chat to Markdown injects a floating MD ▾ panel on supported chat UIs. It converts the visible thread to Markdown (front-matter + User/Assistant turns) or YAML (`messages:` with role/content) and lets you preview, copy, or download. Parsing never leaves the page.

Supported: ChatGPT, Claude (including share pages), Gemini, Le Chat (Mistral), use.ai, Open WebUI (any self-hosted instance). Experimental: grok.com, chat.groq.com.

## Install

Not on the Chrome Web Store yet. Download the release zip, then Chrome/Edge → Extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked.
